diag_title: What do you see on the plant?
diag_armyworm_desc: Caterpillar pest that eats maize leaves, leaving ragged holes and sawdust-like droppings.
diag_armyworm_action: Scout plants early morning. Crush egg masses by hand. Spray in the evening when larvae are active.
dose_armyworm_cap: Mix 2 bottle caps of insecticide per 15 L knapsack sprayer.
diag_blight_desc: Fungal disease causing yellow-brown streaks and spots that spread in wet weather.
diag_blight_action: Remove infected leaves. Avoid working in fields when leaves are wet. Rotate crops next season.
dose_blight_copper: Mix 3 bottle caps of copper fungicide per 15 L knapsack sprayer.
